WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) ns, count(DISTINCT business_date) days_with_sales FROM net_lines
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) ctl_ns, count(*) rows_ctl, SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nz FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) sid, m.ns, c.ctl_ns, round(m.ns-c.ctl_ns,2) diff, m.days_with_sales, c.rows_ctl
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id ORDER BY abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(c.ctl_ns,0)) DESC, 1

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
sales AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2
  GROUP BY 1
),
trading AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store cs
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2
  WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id<900
    AND d.is_trading_day
    AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date<=d.calendar_date)
    AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date>=d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales/t.trading_days DESC) AS rank,
       cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days,
       ROUND(s.net_sales/t.trading_days,2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM sales s JOIN trading t ON t.store_id=s.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank, cs.store_id
